title: WPSB/527/2026 of BINAY KUMAR Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
UKHC010139972026
2026:UHC:6982-DB
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
THE HON'BLE CHIEF JUSTICE MR. MANOJ KUMAR GUPTA
AND
THE HON'BLE JUSTICE MR. SUBHASH UPADHYAY
Writ Petition (S/B) No.527 of 2026
7th August, 2026
Dr. Binay Kumar -----Petitioner
Versus
State of Uttarakhand and Others ----Respondents
-----------------------------------------------------------------
Presence:-
Mr. D.S. Patni, learned Senior Counsel assisted by Mr. Dharmendra
Barthwal and Mr. Himanshu Yadav, learned counsel for the
petitioner.
Mr. Puran Singh Bisht, learned C.S.C. along with Mr. B.P.S. Mer,
learned Standing Counsel and Mr. M.S. Bisht, learned Brief Holder
for the State of Uttarakhand.
-----------------------------------------------------------------
JUDGMENT : (per Mr. Manoj Kumar Gupta C. J.)
1. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
2. The present writ petition has been filed praying
for the following relief:
"a) Issue a writ, order, or direction in the nature of
certiorari quashing impugned order dated 03-08-2026
passed by the respondent no. 1 (Annexure no. 2 to the
instant petition, annexed at page no.22 to page 22 in
the instant petition), to the extent of appointment of
respondent no.4 as Principal, Government Medical
College Rudrapur, District Udham Singh Nagar and
further to direct the respondent no. 1 to open the
petitioner's sealed cover envelope, look into
recommendations of the DPC and act on it and
accordingly appoint the petitioner (as the petitioner
being much senior to the respondent no.4 herein in the
seniority list) from the date when his juniors have been
promoted as Principal of Government Medical College;
Or Alternatively, to quash the impugned order
dated 03-08-2026 passed by the respondent no. 1
(Annexure no. 2 to the instant petition, annexed at page
no.22 to page 22 in the instant petition), to the extent
of appointment of respondent no. 3 as In Charge
Principal, Government Medical College Haridwar and
1

further to direct the respondent no. 1 to open the sealed
cover envelope, look into the recommendations of the
DPC and act on it and accordingly appoint the petitioner
as the petitioner herein, being much senior to the
respondent no. 3, from the date when his juniors have
been promoted as Principal of Government Medical
College.
ii) Issue any other writ, order, or direction as this
Hon'ble Court deems fit and proper in the interest of
justice.
iii) Award costs of the petition to the petitioner."
3. On 14.02.2025, the Additional Director,
Directorate of Medical Education sought consent from 11
Professors for their cases being considered for promotion
as Principal of various Medical Colleges in the State. It
also includes the name of the petitioner. The petitioner is
stated to have given his consent vide letter dated
17.02.2025.
4. An order of transfer dated 03.08.2026 has been
passed whereby various principals have been transferred.
The petitioner has challenged the said order with the
grievance that although the respondents had themselves
initiated the process for promotion of Professors to the
post of Principals and the petitioner had also given his
consent but the petitioner has not been promoted
although in the seniority list his name is at Serial No.4.
According to him, his juniors have been promoted long
back.
2

5. Learned State Counsel has brought on record
the instructions received from the Director, Medical
Education, according to which, a minor punishment was
awarded to the petitioner on 28.07.2020 on basis of which
an entry was made in the ACR of the petitioner in the year
2020-21 and his two increments were also stopped.
6. It appears that because of the said minor
punishment, the DPC when it met in July 2025, kept the
result of the petitioner in sealed cover. According to the
instructions furnished by the Director, the Departmental
Promotion Committee is going to meet soon and in which
the case of the petitioner would also be considered. It is
also stated that order dated 03.08.2026 by which
transfers have been made is a purely ad-hoc
arrangement.
7. Having regard to the fact that the impugned
transfer order is merely transfer of the persons who
already hold the post of Principal, from one Medical
College to another, and is not a promotion order, the same
is not interfered with.
8. As the stand of the Government is that DPC is
going to meet soon and wherein case of the petitioner
would also be considered, we dispose of the petition with
3

direction to the State Government to hold the necessary
exercise in this regard within four weeks from today.
9. Mr. B.P.S. Mer, learned Standing Counsel
undertakes to communicate the instant order to the
competent authority for necessary compliance.
10. Pending application, if any, also stands disposed
of.
 (MANOJ KUMAR GUPTA, C. J.)
